verdict.rationale: Sentry documents a public web API at docs.sentry.io/api, with a stated versioning policy and endpoint docs such as bulk-mutating issues. It also publishes an official machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec ('Sentry Public API') in the getsentry/sentry-api-schema repo, and organization tokens give programmatic auth. The probe 404s at docs-site OpenAPI paths do not contradict this, since the spec lives in the GitHub repo. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving Sentry via the API, evidence of endpoint breadth beyond issues, and a stable versioned API (it is still v0, and beta endpoints are subject to change).
